decisions.reason: As a 2023 extension of the established spraying portfolio that was still shown in 2024, it does not signal a clear performance shortfall below aspiration and likely uses shared capabilities with low additional resource strain.

Its dedicated web presence in both years and the cited field-test reference suggest market validation above the minimum aspiration level, so management would continue it within the core injection business.
Because it builds on proven air-motor technology and remained on the website in 2024, it appears to be a low-risk adjacent product whose results are unlikely to justify withdrawal.
This product had its own page in both years and fits the firm's strategic move toward more digitalized and interoperable customer solutions, so the firm would retain it while learning about demand.

As a 2024 launch close to the established offer, it is still too early to judge it as failing relative to aspiration, and the firm's engineering slack supports keeping it on the market for further evaluation.
